figurative_meaning_en: Sarcastically, reliance on the support or influence of a powerful person
example_sentences_in_bangla: সে মামার জোরে সবকিছু করে ফেলে।
example_sentences_in_english: I got the job through my uncle's influence.
He manages everything with his uncle's pull.
note: This idiom reflects Bengali cultural emphasis on family networks and often used derogatorily to criticize favoritism.
